overview: Cameroon is the strongest health-tech node in Francophone Africa, hosting the largest share of the region's healthtech innovators. Its women's health story runs from GiftedMom, the pioneering maternal-health SMS platform, through GICMED's smartphone-based cervical and breast cancer screening, to a cluster of made-in-Cameroon menstrual health social enterprises. Live 2024-2026 activity centers on accelerator and competition programs and on landmark public health rollouts, notably the nationwide extension of the Cheque Sante maternal health voucher, rather than large femtech equity rounds.

sections.heading: Latest major news
sections.narrative: Recent momentum sits in public health rollouts, competitions, and women-entrepreneurship programs more than in venture rounds.

items.text: Cheque Sante maternal health voucher completes rollout to all ten regions of Cameroon, covering pregnancy and newborn care.
40 women entrepreneurs from Wonder Cameroun cohorts 2-3 graduate in Douala after AfDB/AFAWA-backed acceleration.
Cameroon's Leevlong wins third place in the Orange Summer Challenge with a real-time vital-signs monitoring device.
Cheque Sante maternal health voucher officially launches in the North-West and South-West regions.
Waspito closes a USD 2.5M seed extension led by DP World, bringing total funding to USD 5.2M.

sections.heading: Policy & strategy
sections.narrative: National strategy combines a digital health plan with major maternal-health financing and cervical cancer prevention.

items.text: Cameroon adopts its National Digital Health Strategic Plan 2020-2024, led by MINSANTE, to advance universal health coverage through digital tools.
HPV vaccine introduced into the national Expanded Programme on Immunization to prevent cervical cancer.
Cheque Sante health voucher scheme extended to conflict-affected North-West and South-West regions.
Cheque Sante maternal and neonatal voucher scheme reaches nationwide coverage across all ten regions.

sections.heading: Latest ecosystem moves
sections.narrative: Women-focused activity clusters in accelerators, competitions, and entrepreneurship programs.

items.text: US Embassy Cameroon runs the Academy for Women Entrepreneurs (AWE) 2025 implementation competition.
AfDB/AFAWA Wonder Cameroun (WEEP) program accelerates 500+ Cameroonian women entrepreneurs, run by E4Impact.
Villgro Africa opens women-led African healthtech calls (2024 cohort with J&J Foundation and Boehringer Ingelheim), open to Cameroon.
Disrupt Africa Diversity Dividend reports Cameroon among countries where the share of startups with a female co-founder or CEO decreased over the last two years.
GICMED / GIC Space secures USD 30,000 from HealthTech Hub Africa to scale smartphone-based cervical and breast cancer screening.

sections.heading: Key players & hubs
sections.narrative: The ecosystem spans women's health startups, menstrual-health social enterprises, general telemedicine, and Buea's Silicon Mountain hubs.

items.name: GICMED / GIC Space
items.note: Dr Conrad Tankou's smartphone microscope, smart speculum and telemedicine suite for cervical and breast cancer screening; 15,000+ women screened

items.name: GiftedMom
items.note: Pioneering maternal-health SMS/mobile platform (founded 2013, Yaounde) reaching 500,000+ mothers; later pivoted into Healthlane

items.name: Healthlane
items.note: GiftedMom pivot into preventive/precision health app and clinics; YC W2020, reportedly struggling since 2022

items.name: Kmerpad
items.note: Olivia Mvondo's social enterprise making reusable washable pads and running menstrual-hygiene education; 300,000+ pads distributed since 2012

items.name: KujaEcoPads
items.note: Marie-Claire Kuja's biodegradable banana-fiber sanitary pads and One Million Girls anti-period-poverty campaign

items.name: PridePads Africa
items.note: Biodegradable menstrual pad manufacturing in Ngaoundere plus menstrual education, founded 2019

items.name: Waspito
items.note: All-in-one telemedicine platform (video consults, labs, medication delivery); general e-health, adjacent to femtech

items.name: ActivSpaces
items.note: Tech hub and startup incubator (Buea, Douala, Bangangte), anchor of Buea's Silicon Mountain, founded 2010

items.name: Silicon Mountain (Buea)
items.note: Anglophone tech cluster community around Buea hosting many startups

items.name: Jokkolabs Douala
items.note: Coworking and innovation hub, part of the pan-African Jokkolabs network and AfriLabs member

items.name: Orange Digital Center Cameroon / Orange Fab
items.note: Accelerator with coding school, FabLab, Orange Fab and Orange Ventures for high-potential startups

items.name: MINSANTE (Ministry of Public Health)
items.note: Runs the National Digital Health Strategic Plan, HPV vaccination, and the Cheque Sante maternal voucher scheme
